device_type.description: A device type (type_id of a device descriptor)

i2c_address.description: A 7-bit address on an I2C bus

vm_object.description: A VM object by its id: a variable of the program or one of its elements

vm_accessor.description: A VM accessor by its id: the path a block reads or writes through

vm_block.description: A VM block by its place in the execution order

vm_block_input.description: An input pin of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_output.description: An output pin of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_enable.description: An enable source of a VM block, from 0

vm_block_type.description: A VM block type (wire_id of a block descriptor)

vm_op.description: A command of the VM router

action.description: A stored action by its ID

project_section.description: A section of the stored project by its ID

connector.description: A data connector by its ID

contract.description: A device contract by its ID

tags.name: ERR_POOL_EMPTY
tags.description: no block for a new error
tags.message: The board ran out of room to record error details

tags.name: ERR_ESP_ERR
tags.message: A system call failed ({code})

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BAD_ARG
tags.message: An I2C request is not valid

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BAD_BUS

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BAD_DEV_CFG

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_INIT
tags.message: {bus} could not start on pins {sda} (SDA) and {scl} (SCL)

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_STUCK
tags.description: probe timed out: bus busy, SCL held low or no pull-ups
tags.message: {bus} is stuck while reaching {addr}: check the wiring and pull-ups
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the pull-up resistors, then restart the board.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_RESET
tags.message: {bus} could not be reset

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Nothing answers at {addr} on {bus}
tags.hint: Check that the module is connected and powered, and that its address is right.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_ADD
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} could not be added

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_REMOVE
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} could not be removed

tags.name: ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_ADDED
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} is used before it is added

tags.name: ERR_I2C_NO_ACK
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} did not answer
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_BUS_BUSY
tags.message: {bus} stayed busy while reaching {addr}
tags.hint: Try again; if it repeats, check the wiring of the bus.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_XFER
tags.message: A transfer with {addr} on {bus} failed
tags.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

tags.name: ERR_I2C_REG
tags.message: At register {reg}

tags.name: ERR_I2C_ADDR_TAKEN
tags.description: another device is added at this address
tags.message: {addr} on {bus} is already used by another device
tags.hint: Two devices cannot share an address: change one of them (its address pins or setting).

tags.name: ERR_I2C_REMOTE_DENIED
tags.description: remote op on a bus other than CONFIG_SYS_I2C_REMOTE_BUS
tags.message: {bus} cannot be used from the app
tags.hint: Use the bus the app may reach (the external I2C).

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_KEY
tags.message: In {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_NO_KEY
tags.description: input ended where a key was expected
tags.message: The command ends before it says what it is for

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_UNKNOWN_KEY
tags.message: The board has nothing that answers {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_KEY_TAKEN
tags.message: {key} is registered twice

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_TABLE_FULL
tags.message: No room to register {key}

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_BAD_LINK
tags.message: {link} is not a connection the board knows

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_QUEUE_FULL
tags.message: The board is busy: a command from {link} was dropped
tags.hint: Send commands less often.

tags.name: ERR_ROUTER_FRAME_LEN
tags.description: frame too short or too long
tags.message: A frame of {len} bytes from {link} was refused (at most {max})

tags.name: ERR_UART_LINE_BAD
tags.description: "#R:" line: odd digits, non-hex or too long
tags.message: A serial line of {len} characters is not a valid frame

tags.name: ERR_UART_BAD_ENDPOINT
tags.description: connector binding to an endpoint other than 0
tags.message: The serial port has no endpoint {endpoint}

tags.name: ERR_BLE_STACK
tags.message: Bluetooth failed (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_ADV
tags.message: The board could not start advertising (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_GATT
tags.message: Bluetooth service {uuid} could not be changed (code {rc})

tags.name: ERR_BLE_SVC_LOCKED
tags.message: Bluetooth service {uuid} cannot be changed
tags.hint: This service belongs to the board: add a service of your own instead.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_UUID_TAKEN
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is already in use
tags.hint: Choose another UUID.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} does not exist
tags.hint: Check the UUID, or apply the Bluetooth settings first.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NO_MEM
tags.message: No memory for Bluetooth {uuid} ({size} bytes)
tags.hint: Make the buffers smaller, or remove a characteristic you do not need.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NO_TX
tags.description: no TX buffer, or being removed
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} cannot send
tags.hint: Give the characteristic a send buffer with notify or indicate.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_NO_RX
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} cannot receive
tags.hint: Give the characteristic a receive buffer and allow write.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_TX_FULL
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is full: {len} bytes were not sent
tags.hint: Send less often, or make the send buffer larger.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_RX_FULL
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is full: {len} bytes received were dropped
tags.hint: Write less often, or make the receive buffer larger.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_TOO_LONG
tags.message: {len} bytes are too long for Bluetooth {uuid} (at most {max})
tags.hint: Send less at once, or make the buffer larger.

tags.name: ERR_BLE_BAD_ARG
tags.message: A Bluetooth setting is not valid

tags.name: ERR_BLE_FRAG
tags.description: packet out of order: frame dropped
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid}: a packet came out of order and its frame was dropped

tags.name: ERR_BLE_RX_HANDLER
tags.description: handler already set, or char has an RX buffer
tags.message: Bluetooth {uuid} already has a receiver

tags.name: ERR_CONN_BAD_ID
tags.message: {id} is not a valid connector

tags.name: ERR_CONN_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: {id} does not exist

tags.name: ERR_CONN_EXISTS
tags.message: {id} already exists
tags.hint: Choose another stream ID.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_PROTECTED
tags.description: system connector: no remove, keeps one binding
tags.message: {id} belongs to the system and cannot be changed that way
tags.hint: A system stream keeps one transport: bind another before you unbind this one.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_NO_PROVIDER
tags.message: {provider} is not available
tags.hint: Choose a transport the board has.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_BINDINGS_FULL
tags.message: {id} cannot be bound to more transports
tags.hint: Unbind a transport first.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_TOO_LONG
tags.message: {id}: {len} bytes are too long for {provider} (at most {max})
tags.hint: Send less at once.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_QUEUE_FULL
tags.message: {id} is full: {len} bytes were dropped
tags.hint: Send less often.

tags.name: ERR_CONN_BAD_ARG
tags.message: A connector setting is not valid

tags.name: ERR_CONN_SEND
tags.message: While {id} sent over {provider}

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BAD_ARG

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BAD_ID

tags.name: ERR_DEV_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: {id} does not exist
tags.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check the device ID.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_ID_TAKEN
tags.message: The ID of {id} is already taken
tags.hint: Give the device another ID.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_TABLE_FULL
tags.message: No room for {id}: the board has as many devices as it can hold
tags.hint: Remove a device you do not use.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_TYPE_UNKNOWN
tags.message: The board does not know {type}
tags.hint: Update the board's firmware, or remove the device: this firmware has no driver for it.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_SUSPENDED
tags.message: {id} is suspended
tags.hint: Resume it (Devices: the device, Resume) once the cause is fixed.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_NO_MEM
tags.message: No memory for {id} ({size} bytes)
tags.hint: Remove a device or a part of the program you do not need, then try again.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_INSTALL
tags.message: While creating {id} ({type})

tags.name: ERR_DEV_ID
tags.message: In {id}

tags.name: ERR_DEV_BAD_PIN
tags.message: {id} has no {pin}
tags.hint: Choose a pin the device has.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_RANGE
tags.description: a value the chip would reject (signed: thresholds may be negative)
tags.message: {id}: {value} is outside {min}..{max}
tags.hint: Use a value within the range shown.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_OP
tags.message: In {op}

tags.name: ERR_DEV_UNKNOWN_OP
tags.description: an op (contract) the device doesn't have
tags.message: The device cannot do {op}
tags.hint: This device does not have that command: use one from its list.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_PIN_LOCKED
tags.description: a locked pin: only its owner drives it (sys_pins.h)
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is held by another device
tags.hint: Change the pin through the device that holds it, or choose a free pin.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_IN_USE
tags.description: REMOVE of a device another one uses
tags.message: {id} cannot be removed: {user} uses it
tags.hint: Remove or change that device first.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_DEPS_FULL
tags.message: {id} cannot depend on more devices

tags.name: ERR_DEV_FAULT_RESPONSE
tags.description: the policy's response to an error of device `id` failed (stage: sys_device_fault_stage_e); diagnostics only
tags.message: The response to an error of {id} failed (step {stage}, {action})
tags.hint: Check the device's error policy and the action it runs.

tags.name: ERR_DEV_SYSTEM
tags.message: {id} is part of the board and cannot be removed

tags.name: ERR_IO_PIN_IN_USE
tags.description: SET_MODE of a configured pin; mode = the current one
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is already set up as {mode}
tags.hint: Reset the pin first, or keep its mode: a pin is set up once.

tags.name: ERR_IO_PIN_UNCONFIGURED
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is not set up yet
tags.hint: Set the pin's mode first (Devices: the pin's Mode, or Set mode), then use it.

tags.name: ERR_IO_WRONG_MODE
tags.description: the op doesn't fit the pin's current mode
tags.message: {pin} of {id} is {mode}: it cannot do that
tags.hint: Use a command that fits the pin's mode, or reset the pin and set another mode.

tags.name: ERR_IO_MODE_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: this pin / device can't do the mode
tags.message: {pin} of {id} cannot be {mode}
tags.hint: Choose a mode this pin offers, or another pin.

tags.name: ERR_IO_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: e.g. ADC on a pin without ADC
tags.message: {pin} of {id} does not support that
tags.hint: Use a pin that has it (the device page lists what each pin can do).

tags.name: ERR_IO_PWM_CHANNELS_EXHAUSTED
tags.message: {pin} of {id}: all {channels} PWM channels are in use
tags.hint: Reset a PWM pin you no longer need, or use a PWM expander.

tags.name: ERR_IO_PWM_TIMERS_EXHAUSTED
tags.description: a new frequency needs a timer and none is free
tags.message: {pin} of {id}: no PWM timer is free for {frequency_Hz} (all {timers} in use)
tags.hint: Use a frequency another PWM pin already runs at, or reset a PWM pin you no longer need.

tags.name: ERR_IO_BAD_READING
tags.description: an ADC didn't return the channel asked for
tags.message: {pin} of {id} returned a wrong reading
tags.hint: Read it again; if it keeps failing, restart the board.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: {id} does not exist
tags.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check which action is called.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BUSY
tags.description: a recording or upload is open
tags.message: A recording or upload is already open

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_NO_SESSION
tags.description: no recording / upload of that kind open
tags.message: No recording or upload is open

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_TOO_BIG
tags.message: The action is {len} bytes; at most {max} fit
tags.hint: Split the action into smaller ones.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_OFFSET
tags.message: The upload is out of order (at {got}, expected {want})

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_INCOMPLETE
tags.message: The upload is incomplete ({got} of {want} bytes)
tags.hint: Write it again.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_CRC
tags.message: The upload is damaged (checksum {got}, expected {want})
tags.hint: Write it again.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BAD_FRAME
tags.message: The action is broken at byte {offset}

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_EMPTY
tags.message: The recording has no command
tags.hint: Add a command to the action.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_DEPTH
tags.message: Actions run each other {depth} levels deep: too deep
tags.hint: Make the actions call each other less deep.

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_WRONG_TASK
tags.message: An action was started from the wrong place

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_NO_MEM
tags.message: No memory for the action ({size} bytes)

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_STEP
tags.message: In step {step} of {id}

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BAD_ARG
tags.message: An action request is not valid

tags.name: ERR_ACTION_BAD_ID
tags.message: Action ID 0 is not valid

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_QUEUE_FULL
tags.message: Too many events: {dropped} from {source} were dropped

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_TABLE_FULL
tags.message: No room for another event subscription

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_NOT_FOUND
tags.message: Event subscription {id} does not exist

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_BAD_ARG
tags.message: An event request is not valid

tags.name: ERR_EVENT_DELIVERY
tags.message: While {device} handled event {event} of {source} ({channel})

tags.name: ERR_POWER_BAD_CHANNEL
tags.description: the device has no such channel
tags.message: {id} has no {channel}
tags.hint: Choose a channel the device has.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_ALERT_UNSUPPORTED
tags.description: this channel / device can't do the alert (sys_power_alert_e)
tags.message: {channel} of {id} cannot raise the {alert} alert
tags.hint: Choose an alert this channel offers.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_EXT_FEEDBACK
tags.description: the regulator uses an external divider: its output can't be set in mV
tags.message: {id} uses an external divider: its output cannot be set in mV
tags.hint: Set it in its own terms (the device page says how), not in mV.

tags.name: ERR_POWER_NO_PROFILE
tags.description: the source offers no profile at or below the voltage (lowest_mV: the lowest fixed offer, 5 V when it offers none)
tags.message: {id}: the source offers nothing at or below {voltage_mV} (lowest {lowest_mV})
tags.hint: Use a charger that offers this voltage, or ask for a higher one.

tags.name: ERR_CMD_BAD_LEN
tags.message: The command carries {got} bytes; it needs {need}

tags.name: ERR_CMD_OUT_FULL
tags.description: answer does not fit the link
tags.message: The answer needs {need} bytes; the link takes {cap}

tags.name: ERR_CMD_BAD_ARG
tags.message: A value of the command is not valid

tags.name: ERR_CMD_DIRECTION
tags.description: the command has no such side, or dir is neither read nor write
tags.message: The command has no {dir} side
tags.hint: Read a command that can be read, write one that can be written.

tags.name: ERR_LOG_BAD_LEVEL
tags.message: Log level {level} is above the highest the board has ({max})
tags.hint: Choose a lower level.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_NOT_READY
tags.message: The power manager is not ready

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
tags.description: a rail change that doesn't fit
tags.message: {id} needs {requested_mW}; only {available_mW} is available
tags.hint: Lower the load, switch off another rail, or use a stronger supply.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_BELOW_ALLOCATION
tags.description: the budget shrank under what's committed
tags.message: The power budget fell to {limit_mW}, below the {allocated_mW} the outputs use
tags.hint: The supply gives less than before: lower the load or use a stronger supply.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_FAULT
tags.description: a hardware fault and the response taken
tags.message: {kind} on {channel} of {source} ({value}): {response}
tags.hint: Check what is connected to that output (a short, too much load); the board reacted as its power settings say.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_BAD_ARG
tags.message: {value} is outside {min}..{max}
tags.hint: Use a value within the range shown.

tags.name: ERR_PWRM_NOT_RAIL
tags.description: a matrix row whose target is neither the board nor a rail of it
tags.message: {id} is not a power rail of the board
tags.hint: Choose the board or one of its power rails.
